pixel_pitch_um.source: not published; typical for a 1/2.8 inch 5 MP sensor (2592 x 2.2 um = 5.7 mm wide). Footprint and GSD use the published FOV and pixel count, so this only sets the derived focal length

focal_mm.source: derived: sensor width (px_w x pitch) / (2 tan(fov_h/2)); the published 25 mm is a 35 mm EQUIVALENT, not the lens focal length

exposure_s.source: typical daylight exposure for the blur check (1/2000 s); auto-exposure value is not published; editable

trigger_min_interval_s.source: Photo Shooting Mode, Timelapse TIFF intervals 2/3/5/7/10/15/20/30/60 s, https://ag.dji.com/mavic-3-m/specs
